canonical_statement: For a path-connected, locally path-connected, semilocally simply connected based space (X,x0), the subgroup induced by a pointed path-connected cover is onto all subgroups of pi_1(X,x0), and two such covers induce the same subgroup exactly when they are pointed-isomorphic over X.
domain_and_universes: universe u; X : Type u; TopologicalSpace X; all covering total spaces E : Type u; target Prop in universe 0
conclusion: The fixed inducedSubgroup map from pointed connected covers is surjective, and equality of its values is equivalent to pointed covering isomorphism.

encoding_decisions.semilocal_simple_connectedness: Every point has an open neighborhood U such that the inclusion-induced homomorphism FundamentalGroup U u -> FundamentalGroup X u.1 is trivial for every u : U.
encoding_decisions.pointed_cover: A bundled total type, topology, basepoint, covering map, PathConnectedSpace witness, and basepoint equation.
encoding_decisions.classification: A quotient-free surjectivity-plus-fiber criterion; this is equivalent in intent to bijectivity on pointed-isomorphism classes without assuming a quotient construction.
encoding_decisions.forward_map: Subgroup.range of FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq for the covering map and its basepoint equation.

degenerate_cases: Connected total spaces are required. The identity cover and simply connected (bottom-subgroup) covers remain in scope. No Hausdorff, nontriviality, or cardinality hypothesis is added. Empty bases are excluded by x0 : X.
alternate_encodings: The unpointed conjugacy-class classification and the all-coverings monodromy equivalence remain alternate encodings requiring checked transports; neither replaces this root.
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates the exact pointed target and its definitions. It supplies no classification proof, source acceptance, anchor audit, obligation tree, validation, or theorem-completion evidence.
